info.description:
Control plane of Corvus: pool definitions, dataset snapshots, labels, players and erasure,
blocklist, model registry and training jobs. Corvus never sanctions players itself.

Errors are RFC 9457 problem details (`application/problem+json`). Authenticate with an OIDC bearer
token; roles are `admin`, `data_scientist`, `staff` and `viewer` (`admin` may do everything).
info.title: Corvus control plane

patch.description: Called by the job process with its machine token (`CORVUS_API_URL`, `CORVUS_API_TOKEN`). A job token may only update its own job: the header `X-Corvus-Job-Id` (the job's `CORVUS_JOB_ID`) must equal the id in the path. `succeeded` and `failed` are final; repeating the identical report is accepted.

403.description: A job token needs `X-Corvus-Job-Id` equal to the path id

post.description: Allowed: registered -> shadow -> canary -> enforce, and any stage -> archived. Promotion to `enforce` requires `p99_latency_ms` below the configured limit and `recall_at_fpr_0_1pct` at least that of the model currently enforced on the same snapshot and game context; that model is archived in the same transaction. Every transition is audited.

post.description: In one transaction: deletes the player's key (crypto-shredding), sets `players.erased_at`, blocklists the pseudonym and records an audit row. Compaction of `events` files is a later job; `compaction_pending` stays true until then.
POST so that the UUID never appears in URLs or access logs.
